name: touchHLE iOS (Unofficial)
subtitle: Experimental touchHLE port for modern iPhones
description: Unofficial iOS port of touchHLE. One app carrying two emulator cores, HyperHLE and touchHLE, which support different sets of games; you choose which one runs each game. JIT and legally obtained decrypted 32-bit IPAs are required. Games are not included.

apps.name: touchHLE
apps.subtitle: touchHLE for iOS, with the HyperHLE and touchHLE cores
apps.localizedDescription: The iOS port, carrying both the HyperHLE v1.0.6 and touchHLE 0.2.3 emulator cores. They support different sets of games, so you can pick which one runs each game. JIT must be enabled for each new app process. No games are included.

versions.localizedDescription: Ships both emulator cores in one app and lets you choose which runs each game. Warns when JIT is off instead of closing. Replaces the 0.2.0 app; the separate touchHLE 0.1.0 app can be deleted.
Runs the HyperHLE v1.0.6 core. Fixes landscape touch input, landscape orientation and resolution scaling. Installs alongside the touchHLE build rather than replacing it.

apps.name: touchHLE 0.1.0 (superseded)
apps.subtitle: The old touchHLE-core-only build
apps.localizedDescription: Superseded by the main app from 0.3.0 onward, which carries this core alongside HyperHLE and lets you choose between them. Kept only for anyone already running it; there will be no further updates here.

versions.localizedDescription: First iOS prerelease, running the touchHLE 0.2.3 core.
